svg.aria-label: Traceroute uses ICMP: it sends probes with TTL 1, 2, 3 and so on; each router that decrements TTL to zero drops the probe and replies with ICMP Time Exceeded, revealing itself and the round-trip time; the destination finally replies Port Unreachable.
